args.title: Treat quotes in the middle of unquoted fields as ordinary characters
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Fix CSV parsing so that an unescaped double quote (inch mark) in the middle of an unquoted field does not toggle quote mode and swallow the rest of the line or fail row shape validation. We now only start a quoted field when the quote appears at the beginning of a field (or after a comma).
